pairs: Sed et serpens erat callidior cunctis animantibus terræ quæ fecerat Dominus Deus.
However, the serpent was more crafty than any of the creatures of the earth that the Lord God had made.
And he said to the woman,
Cur præcepit vobis Deus ut non comederetis de omni ligno paradisi?
“Why has God instructed you, that you should not eat from every tree of Paradise?”
De fructu lignorum, quæ sunt in paradiso,
“From the fruit of the trees which are in Paradise,
de fructu vero ligni quod est in medio paradisi,
Yet truly, from the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of Paradise,
God has instructed us that we should not eat,
and that we should not touch it,
Then the serpent said to the woman:
“By no means will you die a death.
Scit enim Deus quod in quocumque die comederitis ex eo,
on whatever day you will eat from it,
and you will be like gods,
Vidit igitur mulier quod bonum esset lignum ad vescendum,
And so the woman saw that the tree was good to eat,
And she took from its fruit,
And she gave to her husband,
And the eyes of them both were opened.
And when they realized themselves to be naked,
Et cum audissent vocem Domini Dei deambulantis in paradiso ad auram post meridiem,
And when they had heard the voice of the Lord God taking a walk in Paradise in the afternoon breeze,
abscondit se Adam et uxor ejus a facie Domini Dei in medio ligni paradisi.
Adam and his wife hid themselves from the face of the Lord God in the midst of the trees of Paradise.
And the Lord God called Adam
Quis enim indicavit tibi quod nudus esses,
“Then who told you that you were naked,
nisi quod ex ligno de quo præceperam tibi ne comederes, comedisti?
if you have not eaten of the tree from which I instructed you that you should not eat?”
whom you gave to me as a companion,
gave to me from the tree,
Et dixit Dominus Deus ad mulierem:
And the Lord God said to the woman,
Et ait Dominus Deus ad serpentem: Quia fecisti hoc,
And the Lord God said to the serpent: “Because you have done this,
maledictus es inter omnia animantia, et bestias terræ:
you are cursed among all living things, even the wild beasts of the earth.
Upon your breast shall you travel,
et terram comedes cunctis diebus vitæ tuæ.
and the ground shall you eat, all the days of your life.
Inimicitias ponam inter te et mulierem,
I will put enmities between you and the woman,
et semen tuum et semen illius:
between your offspring and her offspring.
and you will lie in wait for her heel.”
“I will multiply your labors and your conceptions.
In pain shall you give birth to sons,
and you shall be under your husband’s power,
and he shall have dominion over you.”
he said: “Because you have listened to the voice of your wife,
and have eaten of the tree,
ex quo præceperam tibi ne comederes,
from which I instructed you that you should not eat,
cursed is the land that you work.
in laboribus comedes ex ea cunctis diebus vitæ tuæ.
In hardship shall you eat from it, all the days of your life.
Thorns and thistles shall it produce for you,
and you shall eat the plants of the earth.
In sudore vultus tui vesceris pane,
By the sweat of your face shall you eat bread,
donec revertaris in terram de qua sumptus es:
until you return to the earth from which you were taken.
and unto dust you shall return.”
Et vocavit Adam nomen uxoris suæ,
And Adam called the name of his wife,
eo quod mater esset cunctorum viventium.
because she was the mother of all the living.
Fecit quoque Dominus Deus Adæ et uxori ejus tunicas pelliceas,
The Lord God also made for Adam and his wife garments from skins,
Ecce Adam quasi unus ex nobis factus est,
Adam has become like one of us,
nunc ergo ne forte mittat manum suam,
et sumat etiam de ligno vitæ,
now perhaps he may put forth his hand and also take from the tree of life,
Et emisit eum Dominus Deus de paradiso voluptatis,
And so the Lord God sent him away from the Paradise of enjoyment,
ut operaretur terram de qua sumptus est.
in order to work the earth from which he was taken.
et collocavit ante paradisum voluptatis cherubim,
And in front of the Paradise of enjoyment,
he placed the Cherubim with a flaming sword,
to guard the way to the tree of life.
